role: Where embeddings are indexed for retrieval

options.label: pgvector (Postgres)
options.notes: One database to run; great up to ~1M vectors; reuses your Postgres.

options.label: FAISS (in-process)
options.notes: No service to run; not durable or shared; good for prototypes.

options.label: Managed vector DB (Pinecone/Weaviate)
options.notes: Scales to billions; recurring cost; another vendor; outside the yard.
